_comment_disabled: Set to false to enable this datapack and override the default mod config.
_comment_difficultyIncrement: The amount of difficulty added per second. This is the main way difficulty increases, and is applied when the player is active.
_comment_afkIncrement: The amount of difficulty added per second when the player is AFK. This is applied when the player is idle for more than afkTime seconds.
_comment_afkTime: The amount of idle time in seconds before a player is considered AFK. [Min: 1]
_comment_wakeupIncrement: The amount of difficulty added when the player wakes up from sleep.
_comment_respawnIncrement: The amount of difficulty added when the player respawns. Can be negative to reduce difficulty on death.
_comment_hostileIncrement: The amount of difficulty added when the player kills a hostile mob.
_comment_neutralIncrement: The amount of difficulty added when the player kills a neutral mob.
_comment_mobIncrements: Additional difficulty added when the player kills specific mobs. Each entry defines a difficulty increment and a list of affected mob IDs.
